additions.title: Lions Befrienders — 1:1 Befriender
additions.description: Provide companionship to seniors through regular home visits and calls. Availability depends on referrals and local openings.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. At least one year commitment and orientation training. Confirm the visit schedule with the assigned centre.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. At least one year commitment and orientation training. Confirm the visit schedule with the assigned centre.
discovery.notes: Organiser says it is always recruiting. Linked volunteer application form failed to load. Role text describes fortnightly visits plus calls, while commitment section says weekly visits; confirm frequency.

additions.title: Heartware Youthbank — Youth Volunteering
additions.description: Explore community volunteering programmes through Youthbank, followed by programme enrolment, interview and training.
additions.eligibility: Ages 14–35; individual programmes may add requirements. Interview and training may be required.

discovery.restrictions: Ages 14–35; individual programmes may add requirements. Interview and training may be required.
discovery.notes: Official instructions loaded. Youthbank returned an empty JavaScript page; account and enrolment access not verified. This is a programme-discovery pathway, not a confirmed event slot.

additions.title: University YMCA — Uni-Y Service Programmes
additions.description: University service clubs offer community projects and leadership roles. Enquire with a campus chapter about current volunteering placements.
additions.eligibility: University-student pathway; individual projects have separate commitments and selection. Overseas participation is not confirmed by this entry.

discovery.school_membership: Student chapters listed at NTU, NUS, SMU and SUTD. Confirm membership requirements with the relevant chapter.
discovery.restrictions: University-student pathway; individual projects have separate commitments and selection. Overseas participation is not confirmed by this entry.
discovery.notes: Official programme and joining instructions loaded. Linked sign-up directory failed to load; intake dates and registration route remain unknown.

additions.title: Be My Eyes — Remote Visual Assistance
additions.description: Provide visual assistance to blind and low-vision users through short smartphone video calls when available.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+ under the 2026 terms. Compatible smartphone required; calls matched by language and time zone.

discovery.fees: Free for volunteers; internet/device costs not specified.
discovery.restrictions: Age 18+ under the 2026 terms. Compatible smartphone required; calls matched by language and time zone.
discovery.notes: Official download page loaded; in-app account creation not tested. Calls may be infrequent. No recruitment cutoff or explicit country eligibility confirmed.

additions.title: Science Centre Singapore — Volunteer Programme
additions.description: Help visitors engage with science through activities, explanations and exhibition guidance.
additions.eligibility: Students aged 14+ are welcomed in the official consent form. Role-specific training and availability require confirmation.

discovery.parental_consent: Parent/guardian consent form required for volunteers below 18.
discovery.restrictions: Students aged 14+ are welcomed in the official consent form. Role-specific training and availability require confirmation.

additions.title: HAN Heritage Champions — Volunteer Interest
additions.description: Volunteer-interest lead for promoting Singapore’s cultural heritage through Heritage Activation Nodes.
additions.eligibility: Eligibility requirements not confirmed; check with the organiser.

discovery.notes: Official indexed recruitment summary identifies volunteer-interest registration and training, but the page and FAQ were blocked by JavaScript verification. Age, citizenship, deadlines and registration access remain unknown.

additions.title: UNV Online Volunteering — Assignment Finder
additions.description: Find remote assignments supporting development and humanitarian organisations. Each assignment has its own deadline and required skills.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. Assignment-specific requirements apply; up to 20 hours weekly and 12 weeks per assignment. No financial compensation or benefits.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. Assignment-specific requirements apply; up to 20 hours weekly and 12 weeks per assignment. No financial compensation or benefits.
discovery.notes: Official eligibility explicitly allows applicants anywhere in the world. UVP returned a JavaScript shell, so application flow is unverified. This is an assignment finder, not a guaranteed placement.

additions.title: CS50x — Introduction to Computer Science
additions.description: Self-paced introductory computing course with eleven weeks of material and a final project. Course completion deadline: 30 June 2027, 11:59pm UTC; this is not an application deadline.
additions.eligibility: No prior programming experience or Harvard enrolment required. edX registration required for assessed submissions and certificates; platform age rules not checked.

discovery.fees: OpenCourseWare and CS50 certificate are free; optional verified edX certification is paid, amount unconfirmed.
discovery.restrictions: No prior programming experience or Harvard enrolment required. edX registration required for assessed submissions and certificates; platform age rules not checked.
discovery.notes: Official course instructions and Week 0 learning materials loaded. Access verified for OpenCourseWare only, not assessed submission or paid certification. Enrolment cutoff is unknown.
